162 off-topic results filtered across the following categories:

**Dutch football / Feyenoord-Ueda (30 results):** The 'Ueda' search term for BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda returned extensive coverage of Ayase Ueda, a Japanese striker at Feyenoord in the Dutch Eredivisie. Sources: vi.nl, 1908.nl (multiple), fr12.nl (multiple), footballtransfers.com (multiple), sportnieuws.nl (multiple), rtvnoord.nl (multiple), fcupdate.nl (multiple), fr-fans.nl (multiple), nos.nl, voetbalflitsen.nl, voetbalprimeur.nl, nu.nl, rijnmond.nl (multiple). Also one GQ Japan article about Ueda the footballer and one 'Ayase Ueda becomes a father' item.

**Albanian/Kosovo language articles (23 results):** The 'Jieitai' or other search terms appear to have returned results from Albanian-language outlets covering the White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting, Kosovo politics, handball, road construction, and other completely unrelated matters. Sources: telegrafi.com (multiple), lajmi.net (multiple), rtv21.tv, veriu.info (multiple), 007vox.com, nediber.com, radiokosovaelire.com (multiple), 3shi.net, rahoveci.info, kosovarja-ks.com, vox-al.com, alsat.mk, albeu.com, strugalajm.com.

**Spanish 'mofa' articles (18 results):** The Spanish word 'mofa' (mockery) appears to have been caught by keyword search for 'MOFA' (Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs abbreviation), producing results from Spanish-language sports, politics, and culture coverage entirely unrelated to Japan. Sources: abc.es, eldiadecordoba.es, diariocordoba.com, cordopolis.eldiario.es, larazon.es, pericos.es, lavozdigital.es, okdiario.com (multiple), cronicaglobal.elespanol.com, espinof.com, jaenhoy.es, elsiglodetorreon.com.mx, codigosanluis.com, diariodecadiz.es, cubadebate.cu, eldiario.es, lavanguardia.com.

**UAE MoFA attestation / MoFA UAE diplomatic reaction articles (16 results):** 'MOFA' search returned UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation service pages and UAE MoFA reactions to unrelated events (Trump shooting, Kuwait drone attack, Russia-Ukraine prisoner exchange). Sources: khaleejtimes.com, ndtv.com, timesnownews.com, arabnews.com, dubai92.com (multiple), aninews.in, gulfnews.com (multiple), sharjahattestation.ae, amazonattestation.com, mofa.gov.ae, sheenservices.com, dubai92.com.

**Various 'CDP' false positives (15 results):** CDP search term (Constitutional Democratic Party) returned articles about unrelated CDPs: Continuous Data Protection, Cresyl Diphenyl Phosphate, Chilean/Mexican comités de defensa popular, Italian CDP Venture Capital, customer data platforms, YGOrganization card game, CoinStats CDP (Coinbase Developer Platform), Dominican Republic journalism, EMA clinical data publication, etc.

**'Ministry of Defense' false positives — other countries (14 results):** Results about Mali, Romania, Ukraine, Dominican Republic, Nepal, Azerbaijan, Turkey (SAHA EXPO), Netherlands, UAE, Russia-North Korea, and Israel/UAE Iron Dome. Sources: latimes.com, yoopya.com, diplomat.so (Mali), defence-blog.com, newsukraine.rbc.ua (multiple), razomua.media, eadaily.com, dominicantoday.com, aerotime.aero, besacenter.org, knews.media, c4defence.com, trend.az, gulfnews.com (Iran live).

**'LDP' false positives — other countries (6 results):** Malaysian LDP (Borneo Post), Bangladesh LDP, Welsh LDP (local development plan), Kerala LDF/LDP, Pakistan Lahore Development Programme, Sherwin-Williams Leadership Development Program. Sources: theborneopost.com, dhakatribune.com, walesonline.co.uk, timesofindia.com, nation.com.pk, studentscircles.com.

**Boxing/combat sports (3 results):** Inoue vs Nakatani boxing coverage (independent.co.uk, winnipegfreepress.com) and NJPW wrestling results (bodyslam.net).

**Spanish football (8 results):** CD Tenerife promotion coverage and Córdoba CF match reports, triggered by Spanish-language searches. Sources: eldia.es, diariodeavisos.elespanol.com, apuestas.betfair.es, diariodeleon.es (football), infobierzo.com (basketball).

**US domestic crime/child welfare (7 results):** Baby Jaxon case (Santa Clara County foster care death and resulting charges), New Jersey mass shooting. Sources: sfist.com, cbsnews.com, ktvu.com (multiple), foxla.com, apnews.com (child welfare), dailyvoice.com.

**Celebrity/lifestyle (4 results):** Former Princess Mako Connecticut relocation (20minutos.es, beritaborneo.com, vanitatis.elconfidencial.com), Swedish King's 80th birthday guest list mentioning Emperor Naruhito (mujerhoy.com).

stories.headline: Japan scraps decades-old ban on lethal weapons exports, drawing public protests and regional criticism
stories.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi's Cabinet on April 21 lifted Japan's ban on exporting lethal weapons by revising the Three Principles on Transfer of Defence Equipment, marking a major shift in postwar pacifist policy. The announcement drew domestic protests and criticism from China, while analysts debated its implications for Japan's defense industry and alliance posture.

Separately, cabinet minister Kiuchi and LDP figures visited in person, marking the first confirmed Takaichi cabinet member visit; both North Korea and Russia issued formal condemnations.

stories.headline: Japan's energy security response to Iran war: alternative crude sourcing and Hormuz minesweeper debate
stories.summary: PM Takaichi convened a ministerial meeting on Middle East supply disruption and announced Japan expects to secure around 60 percent of May crude needs via alternative routes, including a 1 million barrel agreement with Mexico. The LDP separately submitted recommendations to Takaichi to consider deploying minesweepers to the Strait of Hormuz once US-Iran fighting ends, a proposal Takaichi acknowledged while noting legal constraints.

stories.headline: Wildfires in northern Japan's Iwate Prefecture force thousands to evacuate over five days
stories.summary: Two large wildfires near Otsuchi town in Iwate Prefecture burned for five consecutive days through April 26, combining to become the third-largest wildfire by area in Japanese recorded history. Authorities deployed 1,400 firefighters and 100 JSDF personnel; over 3,000 residents were ordered to evacuate as flames threatened residential districts.

stories.summary: A 6.1–6.2 magnitude earthquake struck northern Hokkaido on the morning of April 27 at a depth of approximately 80 km, with no casualties or tsunami advisory issued. PM Takaichi urged residents in affected areas to evacuate to higher ground; JR East suspended Shinkansen services between Tokyo and Shin-Aomori.

stories.headline: LDP pushes constitutional reform including emergency clause allowing Diet term extension
stories.summary: At the LDP's April convention, PM Takaichi declared the 'time has come' for constitutional amendment and set a goal of presenting a proposal at the next party convention. stories.headline: Japan's core inflation falls below BOJ 2% target for second straight month
stories.summary: Japan's core CPI in March slowed to below the Bank of Japan's 2 percent target for a second consecutive month, as government fuel subsidies and moderating food prices offset energy shock pressures from the Iran war. The data adds complexity to the BOJ's rate path deliberations.

articles.title: Japan's core inflation stays below BOJ target, energy risks grow

stories.headline: Japan establishes financial cybersecurity task force over AI model vulnerabilities
stories.summary: Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama announced a task force to address cybersecurity risks in Japan's financial system, following concerns about vulnerabilities linked to Anthropic's Mythos AI model. The group involves the FSA, Bank of Japan, National Cybersecurity Office, major banks, and Japan Exchange Group.

stories.headline: SDF manpower capacity under review amid persistent recruitment shortfall
stories.summary: Japan's Ministry of Defense and LDP officials are considering reducing the Self-Defense Forces' maximum personnel capacity as part of a security document revision, acknowledging that current authorized levels are unrealistic for the medium to long term given chronic recruitment shortfalls.
